captions.head: The movie goes dark
captions.sub: The projector's lamp is an arc through xenon. The sound keeps playing.

captions.head: Camera flashes fire nothing
captions.sub: A flash tube is a spark through xenon. Phone LEDs still work.

captions.head: The air is 2 billion tonnes lighter
captions.sub: Pressure drops 0.009 Pa: like raising your head 0.7 mm.

captions.head: Ion engines in space shut off
captions.sub: Probes like Psyche fly on over a tonne of xenon.

captions.head: A dark matter detector empties
captions.sub: 10 tonnes of liquid xenon, 1.5 km underground.

captions.head: Nothing else changes
captions.sub: Xenon is a noble gas. It barely reacts with anything.

captions.head: Xenon is back
captions.sub: The projector's lamp can be struck again.

captions.head: A tsunami
captions.sub: Nothing to do with xenon. Run!
